notes.title: Celebrating the Release of Fellow Developers' Works!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It’s the end of the year again—the time when we’re all dreaming of holidays and the New Year instead of focusing on work. But we, Class Tangerine, are still hard at work on the game dev!

Our new game, Puff Love Story, is progressing nicely! Take a look at our hardworking heroine on set…
—Wait, is this NG scene?

No worries, game development is always a bit chaotic. Please trust that we’ll wrap things up on time!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41386029/14821d2846493b67a639dba67b359fb148e80804.png

By the way, here’s a little plug: our fellow developer’s game Miside has been released! If you’re interested in games with a mix of horror and cute anime girls, be sure to check it out.
And for those Miside players still on the fence about buying Bunny e-Shop, feel free to add it to your wishlist! There will be extra discounts during the winter sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/47574/
